body.purpose: Default reading and operational data text; uses the system sans stack with Traditional Chinese fallbacks and tabular figures.

label.purpose: Compact, semibold labels for fields, status context, and table headings.

shadows.name: sign-in-focus
shadows.purpose: Separates the focused sign-in card from the workspace surface.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Transitions control border, background, text color, and focus shadow.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Reduces animation and transition duration when the user requests reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Teal primary action with a clear hover and keyboard-focus state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 40px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 4px 15px; border: 1px solid var(--sp-primary); border-radius: var(--sp-radius-sm); background: var(--sp-primary); color: var(--sp-surface); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft JhengHei', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: var(--sp-primary-hover); background: var(--sp-primary-hover); color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--sp-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { border-color: var(--sp-primary-hover); background: var(--sp-primary-hover); }

components.name: Work Surface Card
components.description: White, thin-bordered work surface with a quiet 12px corner and no default shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--sp-line); border-radius: var(--sp-radius-md); background: var(--sp-surface); color: var(--sp-ink); padding: 24px; box-shadow: none; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 12px; color: var(--sp-ink); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--sp-muted); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: SupplyPilot is an operational procurement workspace. Its visual language uses modern transport wayfinding: calm dark structure, crisp readable data, and a single visible route through a purchase order's controlled stages. The visual system supports the work; it does not turn the product into an airport board or a chat-first AI interface.
dos: Keep real API capabilities, permissions, business states, transaction safeguards, and failure recovery.
Keep Demand and Recommendations out of V2 primary navigation and styling only as existing legacy routes.
Show document processing, review, and semantic-index states separately; AI citations must point to real document versions and excerpts.
Use Traditional Chinese (Taiwan), Asia/Taipei dates, locale-aware number grouping, and existing currency.
donts: Avoid purple AI gradients, glowing robot imagery, glassmorphism, fake metrics, decorative charts, invented states, and controls with no working behavior.
Do not add notifications, PO export, document attachments, supplier ranking, stock alerts, partial receiving, or automatic payment.
